title: Seahawks vs. Broncos: Listen Live to the Thursday Night Football Game on SiriusXM
summary: Seattle and Denver face off during Week 6 at Empower Field at Mile High, airing live on SiriusXM.
body_markdown:
The[Seattle Seahawks](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/seattle-seahawks) and[Denver Broncos](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/denver-broncos) face off tonight on[Thursday Night Football](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/thursday-night-football-schedule-how-to-listen) — and you can listen to every snap live on SiriusXM on car radios and the SiriusXM app.


[Seahawks vs. Broncos Thursday • 8:15pm ET Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogNFL26-Wk6-SeahawksBroncos)


The Seattle Seahawks are traveling to Denver, Colorado for a week 6 match up against the Broncos. With both teams holding a 3-2 record, Sam Darnold and Joe Burrow are hoping to help their respective teams secure primetime victories and maintain their divisional rankings.


### How to Listen to Seahawks vs. Broncos


**Date:** Thursday, October 15
**Time:** 8:15pm ET
**Location:** Empower Field at Mile High, Denver, Colorado
**Seahawks broadcast:** Ch. 193 (car), Ch. 828 ([app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogNFL26-Wk6-SeahawksBroncos) )
**Broncos broadcast:** Ch. 192 (car), Ch. 809 ([app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogNFL26-Wk6-SeahawksBroncos) )
**National broadcast:**[SiriusXM NFL Radio (Ch. 88)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/siriusxm-nfl-radio) (car and[app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogNFL26-Wk6-SeahawksBroncos) )


### Every NFL Game Airs Live on SiriusXM


Every NFL game, from the regular season through the Super Bowl, is available to SiriusXM listeners both in their vehicles and via the SiriusXM app. Through the SiriusXM app, subscribers can tune in to both home and visiting team broadcasts for every matchup. Additionally, subscribers with sports play-by-play can access both home and road team broadcasts directly on their in-vehicle radios. The schedule of games airing on SiriusXM is available here:[SiriusXM.com/Sports](http://www.siriusxm.com/sports)


Listeners can access NFL game broadcasts and the SiriusXM NFL Radio channel with SiriusXM’s most popular subscription plans, including Platinum, All Access and Music & Entertainment, as well as SiriusXM’s sports-focused subscription plan,[SiriusXM Sports Pass](http://www.siriusxm.com/siriusxmsportspass) , priced at $5 per month.
